package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Use what it adds

Once installed, the integration's contributions appear alongside Core:

- `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component --list` shows its components next to Core components.
- `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list` includes its page and block templates.
- `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme list` lists its themes; add one with `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add <slug> --package @acme/brand-integration`.
- `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs` shows any guides it provides.
- `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search <query>` finds everything, from every installed integration.

Import components at the subpath the integration documents. Run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <Name>` to see the exact import:

```jsx
import {AcmeCarousel} from '@acme/brand-integration/components/AcmeCarousel';
```

For themes, see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs use-a-theme`. To build an integration of your own, see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs authoring`.
